parsed_artifact.argument_markdown:
## Argument

### Step 1: CE obstruction bundle decomposition
By the Casnati-Ekedahl construction for degree-4 covers (SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6), the obstruction to the evaluation map ev: H^0(C, W) -> W|_Gamma splits as H^0(C, omega_C tensor W|_C^vee(Gamma)) = H^0(C, omega_C tensor W_{f_1}|_C^vee(Gamma)) direct-sum H^0(C, omega_C tensor W_{f_2}|_C^vee(Gamma)), where W_{f_i} = O_{P(E^vee)}(2) tensor gamma^* O(-f_i) and F = O(f_1) direct-sum O(f_2) is the Tschirnhausen bundle.

### Step 2: f=4 summand vanishes identically (proved)
For balanced splitting f_1=4, f_2=5 and g=6, the degree of the f=4 obstruction line bundle on a degree-n divisor Gamma is deg(omega_C tensor W_4^vee(Gamma)) = 4*4 + n - 2g - 14 = 16 + 6 - 12 - 14 = -4 (FND-0062, FND-0074). Since the degree is strictly negative, H^0 vanishes on every fibre for every degree-6 divisor Gamma. This is unconditional and independent of the point configuration.

### Step 3: f=5 summand has degree 0 (proved)
For f=5 and the same parameters, deg(omega_C tensor W_5^vee(Gamma)) = 4*5 + 6 - 12 - 14 = 0 (FND-0063, FND-0074). A degree-0 line bundle on a smooth curve has a nonzero section if and only if it is isomorphic to O_C. Therefore evaluation fails on Gamma if and only if omega_C tensor W_5^vee(Gamma) isomorphic to O_C, equivalently O_C(Gamma) isomorphic to L := W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}. (FND-0063.)

### Step 4: Identification of Z^{bal} as Abel-Jacobi incidence (proved)
Combining Steps 2 and 3, on the balanced tetragonal locus the evaluation-failure condition is exactly O_C(Gamma) isomorphic to L. Therefore Z^{bal} is the Abel-Jacobi incidence locus { Gamma in Conf_6(C/B^{bal}) : O_C(Gamma) isomorphic to L } inside the ordered configuration stack.

### Step 5: Riemann-Roch and h^0(L) formula (proved)
L has degree deg(W_5) - (2g-2) = (4g+12-4*5) - 10 = 16 - 10 = 6 for g=6. Riemann-Roch gives chi(L) = 6 - 6 + 1 = 1. Serre duality gives h^1(L) = h^0(omega_C tensor L^{-1}) = h^0(omega_C tensor W_5^vee tensor omega_C) = h^0(omega_C^2 tensor W_5^vee). Setting M := omega_C^2 tensor W_5^vee, deg(M) = 2(2g-2) - deg(W_5) = 20 - 16 = 4. Therefore h^0(L) = 1 + h^0(M). (FND-0073.)

### Step 6: Ordered-to-unordered configuration map (proved)
The forgetful map Conf_6(C/B^{bal}) to the relative effective-divisor space of degree 6 is a finite etale S_6-torsor over the reduced-support open locus. (FND-0064.)

### Step 7: Z^{bal} is open in M_{6,6} (proved direction, closure undetermined)
By FND-0052, the balanced reduced-support relative linear system over the Hurwitz space is an open piece of the failure locus, not a closed pure-codimension-4 subvariety. However, to prove that Z^{bal} is genuinely not closed, an explicit closure point in Z \\ Z^{bal} would need to be exhibited or established (FND-0067), which this argument does not supply.

claims.text: On a smooth genus-6 degree-4 cover C->P^1 with balanced splitting F=O(4)+O(5), the f=4 CE obstruction summand H^0(C, omega_C tensor W_4^vee(Gamma)) vanishes identically for every degree-6 divisor Gamma, because the obstruction line bundle has degree -4.

On the same balanced tetragonal curves, the f=5 CE obstruction summand has degree 0, so it is nonzero if and only if omega_C tensor W_5^vee(Gamma) is isomorphic to O_C, equivalently O_C(Gamma) is isomorphic to L := W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}.
Z^{bal} is exactly the Abel-Jacobi incidence { Gamma in Conf_6(C/B^{bal}) : O_C(Gamma) isomorphic to L }.
L has degree 6, chi(L)=1, and h^0(L) = 1 + h^0(M) where M = omega_C^2 tensor W_5^vee has degree 4.
The forgetful map Conf_6(C/B^{bal}) to (Sym^6 C)_{red-supp} is a finite etale S_6-torsor over the reduced-support open.

claims.caveat: An explicit closure point in Z \\ Z^{bal} is not exhibited (FND-0067).
claims.text: Z^{bal} is an open piece of the failure locus in M_{6,6}, not a closed pure-codimension-4 subvariety.

gap_markers.text: No explicit closure point in Z \\ Z^{bal} is exhibited to establish that Z^{bal} is not closed in M_{6,6}. Openness of balancedness and one balanced example are insufficient (FND-0067).

It is not proved that h^0(L)=3 (i.e., h^0(M)=2) is constant across the balanced locus. Without constancy, the fibre dimension of Z^{bal} over the Hurwitz space and its codimension in M_{6,6} (claimed as 4 / dim 17 in prior work) are not established (FND-0058).

Riemann-Roch chi(L)=1 proves only that the full Abel-Jacobi fibre in Sym^6 is nonempty; it does not prove that the reduced-support ordered incidence Z_ev is nonempty on every geometric fibre (FND-0083).

The identification of Z^{bal} with the Abel-Jacobi incidence is established fibrewise on geometric points. Scheme-theoretic or determinantal/Fitting ideal comparison is needed to upgrade to an identification of moduli stacks (FND-0046).

parsed_artifact.summary: On balanced tetragonal genus-6 curves, the six-point CE evaluation-failure locus Z^{bal} is identified as the Abel-Jacobi incidence for the f=5 degree-0 obstruction summand; the f=4 summand vanishes identically; the ordered-to-unordered configuration map is a finite etale S_6-torsor. Closure, h^0-constancy, and scheme-theoretic identification remain open.
parsed_artifact.theorem_statement: On the moduli stack of smooth genus-6 curves equipped with a balanced tetragonal structure (splitting F = O_{P^1}(4) + O_{P^1}(5)), the Casnati-Ekedahl evaluation-failure locus Z^{bal} for ordered six-point configurations is exactly the Abel-Jacobi incidence locus { Gamma in Conf_6(C/B^{bal}) : O_C(Gamma) is isomorphic to L := W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1} }. The f=4 CE obstruction summand H^0(C, omega_C tensor W_4^vee(Gamma)) vanishes identically on every degree-6 divisor, and the f=5 summand has degree 0, so its nonvanishing is equivalent to the single line-bundle triviality condition omega_C tensor W_5^vee(Gamma) isomorphic to O_C. The line bundle L has degree 6, chi(L)=1, and h^0(L) = 1 + h^0(M) where M := omega_C^2 tensor W_5^vee has degree 4. The forgetful map from the relative ordered configuration stack Conf_6(C/B^{bal}) to the reduced-support open of the relative degree-6 linear system is a finite etale S_6-torsor. The closure of Z^{bal} in M_{6,6} and the constancy of h^0(L) across the balanced locus are not determined.
